source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"An occlusive dressing serving fairly little specific purpose for a client with a chest tube in place","B":"This particular type of dressing being needed only for the first 24 hours after the tube is first inserted","C":"It helps create an airtight seal at the insertion site, preventing air from entering the pleural space around the tube","D":"A non-occlusive dressing being considered just as effective as an occlusive one for this particular purpose"}}
source_row.rationale: An occlusive dressing over a chest tube insertion site helps create an airtight seal, preventing air from entering the pleural space around the tube (which could compromise the negative pressure system and potentially cause a pneumothorax), an important consideration throughout the duration the chest tube remains in place.
